verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the core product is a fair question for a design-tool SaaS. However, the evidence only shows a 'Self-Hosted' export that packages a finished scene and the Spline runtime as a ZIP. That lets you host your output, not the Spline editor itself, so it is an adjacent feature. The docs describe the core product as cloud-based ('your files live in the cloud'), with the desktop app a wrapper around that service, and nothing documents running the editor or backend on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The Self-Hosted export option in Spline allows you to export your entire project, including all assets and the Spline runtime, as a fully self-contained ZIP file.
